prompt: How much energy is needed to melt 0.50 kg of ice at 0 °C? (Specific latent heat of fusion $= 3.3\times10^5$ J kg⁻¹)

A 2.0 kW kettle heats 1.5 kg of water from 20 °C to 100 °C. ($c = 4200$ J kg⁻¹ K⁻¹, $L_v = 2.26\times10^6$ J kg⁻¹)

**(a)** Calculate the energy needed to reach boiling point. **[1]**

**(b)** Estimate the time taken, stating one assumption. **[2]**

**(c)** The kettle is left on for a further 2.0 minutes. Calculate the mass of water boiled away. **[2]**
markscheme:
**(a)** $1.5\times4200\times80 = 5.04\times10^5$ J ✓

**(b)** $t = 5.04\times10^5/2000 = 252$ s ✓; assume no energy lost to surroundings/kettle ✓

**(c)** $E = 2000\times120 = 2.4\times10^5$ J ✓; $m = 2.4\times10^5/2.26\times10^6 = 0.11$ kg ✓
